setlist.title: Caution (Do Not Stop On The Tracks)

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Caution (Do Not Stop On The Tracks)** (2 reviews): The feedback section is described as very inventive; Caution leading into Feedback is singled out as a highlight, with Phil dominant across the show [6][7]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Lovelight rocks, with Pigpen sounding in top form [7]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Dark Star beautiful enough to justify downloading the show on its own [3]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Garcia seems entranced, repeating a three-note figure over and over during The Eleven [10]

## The recordings

- **gd68-10-20.sbd.miller.21441.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 64 min; rated 4.72/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: This cleaned-up version improves on flawed source; Taper's Compendium rates it B, reviewer would now give A; Recording captures only a fragment of a longer set; Reviewer finds every instrument and vocal crystal clear on the recording [3][5][6][9][14]
- **gd1968-10-20.sbd.miller.9071.shnf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 64 min; rated 3.9/5 by 21 [2]

## Around the show

- The band did not return to the Greek for another 13 years, which the reviewer finds puzzling [3]
- Show points toward the much longer Dark Star jams of 1969 [4]
- This Saint Stephen is favored over the sluggish versions played in the late 1970s [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-10-20.sbd.miller.21441.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard source transferred through reel-to-reel, DAT, CD and Sonic Solutions to CD, circulated via Charlie Miller [1]
- **gd1968-10-20.sbd.miller.9071.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Rm -> Dat -> CD -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @donelichterman: [Exploring Grateful Dead's Iconic Performance at Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA in 1968 - The Grateful Dead Live](https://thegratefuldeadlive.com/exploring-grateful-deads-iconic-performance-at-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca-in-1968/) [16]
- Poster by Mp3Caprice.com: [1968.10.20 - Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA](https://mp3caprice.com/release/1968-10-20-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca-144821) [17]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 10/20/68 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759946163/) [18]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759946163/) [19]
